**Signature:**


## Remarks

Passed to `new Gramstax(params)`<!-- -->. The constructor validates `token`<!-- -->, `deploy`<!-- -->/`optionsDeploy` membership, and numeric ranges (`_validateConfig`<!-- -->) and throws with an explicit message on violation.
